% A test for tex8web: equation* as the PDF has it. Its \label gives a
% \ref the section's number, and a split's second column starts with {} so
% that its relation is spaced as one.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\begin{document}
\section{S}
\begin{equation*} a = b \label{eq:s} \end{equation*}
\begin{equation*} \begin{split} a &= b \\ &= c \end{split} \end{equation*}
See \ref{eq:s}.
\end{document}
